source: Phase 1 audit of REFERENCE APPS/<app>.html — see docs/lesson-plans/exercise-palette.md for narrative overview

common_universal_parameters.description: Every app exposes these page-level + theme-level controls. Listed once here; per-app entries omit them unless the app's contract diverges.

parameters.description: Image library language; drives which translations and locale-aware behaviors apply.
Fallback background color when no theme is applied.
Add name/date fields to worksheet header.

apps.name: addition
apps.title: Image Addition Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Solve addition problems by counting themed images in two operand groups and writing or selecting the sum.

customization_parameters.description: Arithmetic structure: standard sum (image-image), mixed image+number, or find-the-missing-addend.
Display the '+' operator between operand groups.
Use child-friendly answer box layout vs. minimal.
Display written numerical form (e.g., '3 + 2 = __') alongside images.

prerequisite_skills: can write or type a single-digit number
apps.image_consumption: yes — themed image library; one image per item-in-group; vocab labels surface in answer key
apps.notable_quirks: find-addend mode is a missing-operand puzzle (images − ? = result), unique cognitive shape vs. standard sum. min/max operand range 1-10 prevents zero-quantity groups.

apps.name: subtraction
apps.title: Image Subtraction Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Solve subtraction problems with image groups, optionally crossing out items to visualize taking-away.

customization_parameters.description: Subtraction structure: visual cross-out, mixed image-number, or find-the-subtrahend.
Display written numerical form alongside images.

prerequisite_skills: can write or type a single-digit number
apps.image_consumption: yes — themed image groups; cross-out mode visually crosses removed items
apps.notable_quirks: cross-out is the only traditional visual-subtraction mode in the catalog; find-subtrahend mirrors addition.find-addend cognitive shape.

apps.name: code-addition
apps.title: Code Addition Worksheet (cipher-style)
apps.mechanical_action: Solve symbol+symbol=number puzzles to crack a letter-to-number cipher; optionally reveal a hidden word as answers are filled in.

customization_parameters.description: Enable hidden-word reveal: each correct answer fills one letter of a target word.
Word to reveal letter-by-letter (active only when wordRevealMode=true).
Number of unique symbols in the cipher key.
Smallest value any symbol can map to.
Largest value any symbol can map to.

prerequisite_skills: maps symbols to values via a key
apps.image_consumption: no — symbols and numerals only (despite IMAGE_VOCABULARY load, no theme images displayed)
apps.notable_quirks: default exerciseMode emits null per §17.8.5 default-mode-emits-null contract (Commission ε at `109a91d4`); word-reveal motivator caps problem count at length of secret word.

apps.name: more-less
apps.title: Compare Numbers Worksheet (More/Less)
apps.mechanical_action: Compare two quantities (image groups, image+number, or two image sets) and identify which is more or less.

customization_parameters.description: Use same image type for both groups (5 cats vs 7 cats) or different (5 cats vs 7 dogs).
Problems for check-cross mode (active in that mode only).

apps.image_consumption: yes — themed image groups
apps.notable_quirks: check-cross mode (mark larger, cross smaller) is unique within the catalog — no typed answer; image-variety toggle changes cognitive load (same-images = pure counting; different-images = transfer reasoning).

apps.name: math-puzzle
apps.title: Math Puzzle Worksheet (grid-constraint)
apps.mechanical_action: Solve a 2×2 / 3×3 / 4×4 grid where row + column sums constrain missing cell values.

customization_parameters.description: Optional image theme for cell decoration.

apps.image_consumption: optional — images decorate cells; puzzle is fundamentally arithmetic
apps.notable_quirks: one puzzle per worksheet (no problemCount); 4×4 grid is genuinely hard for K-1.

apps.name: math-worksheet
apps.title: Math Worksheet (multi-symbol equations)
apps.mechanical_action: Solve multi-symbol equations (e.g., ◆ + ● = ■, □ + ◆ − ● = __) by tracking symbol-to-number mappings.

customization_parameters.description: Manual image selection vs theme-driven auto-pick.

prerequisite_skills: solves equations with one or more unknowns
apps.image_consumption: optional — symbols can be theme-driven (apples + cars + ...) or pure shapes
apps.notable_quirks: hard difficulty (4 symbols) crosses into Grade 3 cognitive territory; equation-string concatenation pattern breaks in Finnish (case marking) per project_brief_a_translation_debt — cross-locale renderer needed.

apps.name: alphabet-train
apps.title: Alphabet Train Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Identify which letter starts the picture in each train car; fill in target letters.

customization_parameters.description: Number of pre-filled image clues (rest are blank).

prerequisite_skills: matches images to starting letters (phonemic awareness)
apps.image_consumption: yes — image library; each car shows an image whose name starts with the matching letter
apps.notable_quirks: fixed 11-letter structure; landscape orientation default; clueCount controls scaffold density (more clues = lower demand).

apps.name: pattern-train
apps.title: Pattern Train Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Identify a repeating pattern (AB / AAB / ABB / ABC / AABB) and continue or fill missing positions in a train.
apps.image_consumption: yes — image library; pattern positions filled with theme images
apps.notable_quirks: 5 pattern-unit choices map to increasing cognitive load; landscape default.

apps.name: prepositions
apps.title: Prepositions Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Identify or write the spatial preposition (in / on / under / next-to / behind / between / above / in-front-of) describing the relationship of an item to an anchor shape.

customization_parameters.description: Anchor shapes source (8 default shapes: circle, cube, cylinder, heart, hexagon, square, star, triangle).

prerequisite_skills: selects from multiple choices OR writes a single word
apps.image_consumption: yes — items + shapes
apps.notable_quirks: dual-grid system (items + anchor-shapes); supports gender-aware articles + dative contractions in German; multilingual preposition + shape translations baked in.

apps.name: word-guess
apps.title: Image Clue Word Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Look at an image and fill in missing letters to spell its name.

customization_parameters.description: Number of pre-filled clue letters per word (0=none, 6=most).
Allow operator to override individual word labels before generation.
Use typed word list instead of image library (text-only mode).

apps.image_consumption: yes — image library; or text-only via custom-word-list mode
apps.notable_quirks: difficulty inverse to challenge (0 clues = hardest); custom-list mode disables image consumption; case-insensitive evaluation but case-sensitive display.

apps.name: word-scramble
apps.title: Word Scramble Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: View scrambled letters with an image clue and write the unscrambled word.

customization_parameters.description: Pre-filled clue letters per word (clue density).

apps.image_consumption: yes — image library; or text-only via custom-list
apps.notable_quirks: vowel/consonant color-coding is orthogonal to image library.

apps.name: wordsearch
apps.title: Word Search Puzzle
apps.mechanical_action: Find hidden words in a letter grid by dragging across connected letters in any of 8 directions.

customization_parameters.description: Show only image clues (no word list).
Show only word list (no image clues).

apps.image_consumption: yes — themed words; image clues optional
apps.notable_quirks: internal THEME_DB_MAP translates UI theme names to DB names (e.g., food → food_bw); wall-of-letters fills non-word cells with non-word-forming distractors.

apps.name: cryptogram
apps.title: Image Cryptogram Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Decode a substitution cipher: each unique letter in a phrase maps to an image; the kid uses the legend to fill in the plaintext.

customization_parameters.description: Number of letters pre-revealed in the legend (scaffold).

apps.image_consumption: yes — one image per unique letter in cipher
apps.notable_quirks: asymmetric image-to-letter binding (one image per distinct letter); per-letter assignment UI surfaces 26 slots; reveal-count is inverse difficulty.

apps.name: big-small
apps.title: Big and Small Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Identify which of two same-category objects is bigger or smaller, or order N objects by size.
apps.image_consumption: yes — same-category images at varying scales
apps.notable_quirks: minimal customization; size-rendering native (does not require pre-sized variant assets).

apps.name: pattern-worksheet
apps.title: Pattern Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Complete a repeating visual pattern (AB / AAB / ABC / AABB / ABBC / AABC / ABCC / ABCD) by tapping options or filling blanks.
apps.image_consumption: yes — themed images per pattern element (2-4 distinct images per pattern type)
apps.notable_quirks: two-tier configuration (global + per-puzzle); 9 pattern types span K-Grade-3 cognitive ranges.

apps.name: find-and-count
apps.title: Find and Count Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Look at a grid of mixed images, identify a target, and count how many appear; tap each instance to mark.
apps.image_consumption: yes — grid populated with target + distractor images
apps.notable_quirks: grid size scales difficulty (5×5 = 25 cells, 10×10 = 100 cells); answer key shows target locations.

apps.name: find-objects
apps.title: Find Objects (I-Spy / Odd-One-Out)
apps.mechanical_action: Tap-to-mark targets in a busy scene (I-Spy mode) OR identify unpaired images in a paired set (Odd-One-Out mode).
apps.image_consumption: yes — busy scene composition (I-Spy) or paired grid (Odd-One-Out)
apps.notable_quirks: shared runtime across two pedagogically distinct modes; rotation/scale-aware bbox detection in I-Spy.

apps.name: chart-count
apps.title: Bar-Chart Counting Worksheet
apps.mechanical_action: Count items in a scene by category, then fill a bar-chart cell-by-cell to visualize the count.
apps.image_consumption: yes — count-scene + per-category bar-graph icons
apps.notable_quirks: category count + objects-per-category determined by content; minimal explicit configuration.

apps.name: matching
apps.title: Matching Worksheet (column pairs)
apps.mechanical_action: Draw lines between matching items (image↔letter, image↔word, image↔image) on left and right columns.

customization_parameters.description: Match shape: image↔letter, image+word↔image+word, mixed image/word, or image↔custom-word.

apps.image_consumption: yes — image+letter or image+word pairs
apps.notable_quirks: imgorfname mode allows per-row toggle (left/right can be image OR word independently); imgorfname has internal sub-modes.

apps.name: shadow-match
apps.title: Shadow Match (or Make-It-Whole)
apps.mechanical_action: Match an image to its silhouette (shadow-match) OR match a fragmented image piece to the whole image (make-it-whole).
apps.image_consumption: yes — images + corresponding shadows OR fragmented pieces
apps.notable_quirks: make-it-whole produces directional rectangular cuts (not jigsaw).

apps.name: grid-match
apps.title: Grid Match (drag-into-slots)
apps.mechanical_action: Drag clue-image tiles into a grid to complete a target picture.
apps.image_consumption: yes — theme-based, custom upload supported
apps.notable_quirks: deferred-Check-Answers feedback model (Family F).

apps.name: bingo
apps.title: Picture Bingo
apps.mechanical_action: Drag chips onto matching cells of a 5×5 bingo card; caller bar (optional) names target images for literacy reinforcement.
apps.image_consumption: yes — 5×5 grid + caller chip strip
apps.notable_quirks: 5×5 fixed grid; caller bar is announce-only (no chip pre-highlight) per MEMORY's literacy-purity discipline.

apps.name: picture-sort
apps.title: Picture Sort (binary categorization)
apps.mechanical_action: Drag images into one of two bins based on a category rule.
apps.image_consumption: yes (theme mode) — image library; OR text-tile mode in custom-words
apps.notable_quirks: strict per-item scoring; custom-words mode renders text as draggable tiles instead of images.

apps.name: missing-pieces
apps.title: Missing Pieces (shape-masked drag)
apps.mechanical_action: Drag a shape-masked piece (circle / portrait-rect / landscape-rect / portrait-ellipse / landscape-ellipse) into its matching hole on a larger picture.
apps.image_consumption: yes — single source image; pieces are shape-masked crops
apps.notable_quirks: shape complexity scales difficulty (circle = easiest, ellipse = hardest); 2-6 distractors.

apps.name: sudoku
apps.title: Picture Sudoku (4×4 / 6×6)
apps.mechanical_action: Place pictures into a 4×4 or 6×6 grid such that each row, column, and sub-grid contains each picture once.

customization_parameters.description: Number of blank cells (drives mode emit: 4→null/easy, 6→medium, 8→hard).

apps.image_consumption: yes — picture-sudoku uses 4 or 6 distinct images per puzzle
apps.notable_quirks: default mode (difficulty=4) emits null per §17.8.5 default-mode-emits-null contract; image-index matching (duplicate images interchangeable across cells).

apps.name: treasure-hunt
apps.title: Treasure Hunt (locked-start drag-trace)
apps.mechanical_action: Read direction clues, drag from a fixed start cell along the implied path; intermediate cells must be visited in order.
apps.image_consumption: yes — busy scene + hidden treasure markers
apps.notable_quirks: 5×5 grid, no walls, hidden endpoint; solutionPath traverses every intermediate cell so multi-step direction clues require enacting both segments.

apps.name: picture-path
apps.title: Picture Path (maze drag)
apps.mechanical_action: Drag a continuous path through a maze (pathway / classic-maze / choose-path), avoiding walls and dead-ends.

customization_parameters.description: Number of paths in choose-path mode.

apps.image_consumption: yes — waypoint images at start/end/along-path
apps.notable_quirks: LPF (Longest Path First) maze algorithm; perfect mazes (no loops); choose-path supports collectibles variant.

apps.name: odd-one-out
apps.title: Odd One Out
apps.mechanical_action: Pick the image in a 4-image set that doesn't belong to the other three's category.
apps.image_consumption: yes — semantic groupings of 3 + 1 odd
apps.notable_quirks: Family A choice-tap variant with deferred Check; reveal-correct on wrong.

apps.name: crossword
apps.title: Image Crossword
apps.mechanical_action: Fill a 2D crossword grid using image clues for Across and Down entries; letters at intersections satisfy two words.
apps.image_consumption: yes — image clues per Across/Down entry; or text-only via custom-list
apps.notable_quirks: first 2D-grid Family A port; per-cell direction toggle on dual-direction cells; click-clue-to-focus-word flow.
